death_time_s.definition: Match time of each death. Histogram in 60 s bins from 0 to 900 s, split by cause (by_bot, storm, paired_killed).
death_time_s.label: When deaths happen
limitations: Storm deaths only happen late in a match.

deaths.definition: Death and storm-death rows in human files: by_bot = BotKilled, storm = KilledByStorm, paired_killed = the Killed half of a Kill/Killed pair.
deaths.label: Deaths
limitations: No human journey has more than one death.
The cause of a paired Killed is unknown.

distance.definition: Sum of straight-line steps between consecutive positions inside path segments, in world units (UV distance x map scale). Histogram in 250-unit bins from 0 to 3000.
distance.label: Distance travelled
limitations: A lower bound: positions are about 5 s apart and joined by straight lines.
Gaps over 30 s add nothing.
The clicked-route card computes from rounded positions, so it may differ slightly.

first_loot_s.definition: Match time of the journey's first loot row. Histogram in 15 s bins from 0 to 300 s, plus an overflow bin.
first_loot_s.label: Time to first loot
limitations: Shows when a pickup was logged, not when the player reached the item.
first_loot_s.population: Human journeys with loot (the rest have no loot recorded)

grid_cells_observed.definition: Non-zero cells of the published traffic heatmap for the slice, out of the 64 x 64 grid.
grid_cells_observed.label: Grid cells with observed human traffic
limitations: Not '% of map explored': the grid includes unreachable and off-map area.
Cell size differs by map, and coverage grows with the sample, so maps aren't directly comparable.
Per map only (null for all maps).

human_journeys.definition: Count of human journeys (one human file in one match, after cleaning) in the slice.
human_journeys.label: Human journeys
limitations: Recorded journeys only; most matches have one recorded human (EC-25).

human_players.definition: Distinct player pseudonyms with a human journey in the slice.
human_players.label: Players observed
limitations: Player pseudonyms, not people; never add this across slices.

journey_span_s.definition: Last record minus first record of the journey (positions and events; rows after the death are excluded, D2). Histogram in 60 s bins from 0 to 900 s.
journey_span_s.label: Recorded journey span
limitations: Not a session length: recording may start late or stop early.
Differs from estimated movement time whenever a journey has a gap over 30 s.

journeys_per_player.definition: Human journeys per player; histogram bins 1, 2, 3, 4-5, 6-10 and 11+.
journeys_per_player.label: Journeys per player
limitations: Observed repeat activity in this 5-day window, not retention; a single-date slice only sees that day.

journeys_with_death.definition: Human journeys with a death row.
journeys_with_death.label: Journeys that ended in a death
limitations: The rest are 'no death recorded'. Extraction is not recorded (EC-13), so any extraction label is inferred.

journeys_with_loot.definition: Human journeys with at least one loot row.
journeys_with_loot.label: Journeys with any loot

kill_killed_pairs.definition: A Kill and a Killed in the same file and the same second (EC-12).
kill_killed_pairs.label: Kill/Killed pairs
limitations: Cause unknown: the rows can't tell a self-inflicted death from a trade with an unrecorded player, so they are neither self-kills nor PvP.

kill_rate.definition: Counted kills divided by human journeys: the mean of kills per journey.
kill_rate.label: Kills per journey (average)
limitations: A rate, so maps with different sample sizes can be compared; the total is Kills.

kills.definition: Counted kills in human files: kill rows that aren't half of a Kill/Killed pair. Kills logged after the player's death count, as on the heatmaps and in the match list.
kills.label: Kills
limitations: All counted kills in this data are BotKill events.
Position is where the killer stood.

kills_per_journey.definition: Counted kills per human journey, zeros included; the sum equals Kills.
kills_per_journey.label: Kills per journey
limitations: The clicked-route card leaves kills logged after the death out, so it can differ by one for those journeys.

loot_events.label: Loot pickups
limitations: Several pickups can share one second (EC-03); none are deduplicated (D3).

loot_per_journey.definition: Loot rows per human journey, zeros included.
loot_per_journey.label: Loot per journey

loot_rate.definition: Loot pickups divided by human journeys: the mean of loot per journey.
loot_rate.label: Loot per journey (average)
limitations: A rate, so maps with different sample sizes can be compared; the total is Loot pickups.

map_score.definition: The three maps at the same date compared on five parts: human journeys, median recorded journey span, kills per journey and loot per journey (higher is better), and storm deaths per 100 journeys (lower is better). Each part is scaled so the best map at that date is 1 and the worst is 0 (all equal: 0.5); the score is the equal-weight mean of the five parts (S, 2026-10-23).
map_score.label: Map performance score
limitations: A comparison between maps, not a measure of quality: with three maps the best and worst always get 1 and 0 on every part, so small gaps look large.
The weights and directions are a design choice, not a property of the data.
A map with few matches counts like any other; check its sample.
Per map only (null for all maps), and null when fewer than two maps have a human journey.
map_score.population: Maps with a human journey at the date

matches.definition: All matches in the match index for the slice, with or without a human journey.
matches.label: Recorded matches
limitations: Includes bot-only and unknown-only matches.

matches_with_human.definition: Matches in the slice with at least one human journey; equals the heatmaps' sample.
matches_with_human.label: Matches with a human journey
limitations: The sample every human statistic rests on; sample sizes differ by about 10x between maps.

movement_time_s.definition: Sum of the gaps between consecutive positions inside path segments (gaps of at most 30 s, D5). The sum equals the traffic heatmap's total.
movement_time_s.label: Estimated movement time
limitations: An estimate, not measured playtime.
Separate from the recorded journey span.

players_by_days_observed.definition: Players by the number of distinct UTC match dates they have a human journey on.
players_by_days_observed.label: Days a player was seen
limitations: Partial boundary days (2026-02-09, 2026-02-14) shorten the window.
Observed repeat activity in this 5-day window, not retention; a single-date slice only sees that day.
players_by_days_observed.population: Players observed; all-dates slices only (null for a single date)

repeat_players.definition: Players with 2 or more human journeys in the slice.
repeat_players.label: Players seen more than once
limitations: Observed repeat activity in this 5-day window, not retention; a single-date slice only sees that day.

storm_death_rate.definition: Storm deaths (KilledByStorm) divided by human journeys, times 100.
storm_death_rate.label: Storm deaths per 100 journeys
limitations: Storm deaths only happen late in a match.
